title: 103 Early Hints are opt-in, and never go to HTTP/1.0
why: nginx below 1.29 takes a 103 as the final response: the real response loses the edge headers and only ends when the keep-alive expires.
changelog: Fix: the Node server no longer sends 103 Early Hints by default; set `server.earlyHints` or `BRAIN_EARLY_HINTS=1` to opt in, never for HTTP/1.0
Fix: page responses carry the route preloads in a `Link` header, so hosts can still produce early hints
